1. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: applying a first coating material on a threaded region of an opening in a multi-piece assembly, wherein the first coating material is applied __only to the threaded region and does not extend to any load surface of the multi-piece assembly__; inserting at least one fastener to the threaded region, the fastener including a mating thread selectively secured to the threaded region of the opening to create a first friction interface between the fastener and the multi-piece assembly; and tensioning the fastener between a load surface of the multi-piece assembly and a mating thread of the fastener to define a second friction interface between the multi-piece assembly and the fastener, the second friction interface being spaced away from the threaded region such that the first coating material does not influence the second friction interface.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising establishing the first coating material as being applied solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads, __wherein the first coating material comprises a thread-locking adhesive that cures after insertion of the fastener__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising adjusting the first friction interface independent of the second friction interface, __wherein the first friction interface is adjusted by controlling the amount and distribution of the first coating material prior to fastener insertion__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3, wherein adjusting the first friction interface includes adjusting an amount of the first coating material applied to the threaded region, thereby increasing friction at the first friction interface without affecting friction at the second friction interface, __and wherein the adjustment is made by varying the application technique or duration of coating application__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein applying the first coating material includes filling the opening at least partially with a coating fluid, __wherein the coating fluid is applied exclusively to the threaded region and cures to form a solid coating layer__.

9. (Original) The method of claim 1, further comprising providing a second coating material at the second friction interface.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the second coating material includes a corrosion-resistant coating, __and wherein the second coating material is applied to a fastener head or washer surface that defines the second friction interface__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive, __and wherein the thread locking adhesive is anaerobic and cures in the absence of oxygen after fastener insertion__.

12. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: applying a first coating material on a threaded region of an opening in a first multi-piece assembly included in a plurality of multi-piece assemblies, wherein the first coating material is applied __only to the threaded region and does not extend to any load surface of the multi-piece assembly__; inserting at least one fastener to the threaded region, the fastener including a mating thread selectively secured to the threaded region of __the opening__ to create a first friction interface between the fastener and the first multi-piece assembly, the fastener having a second coating material; tensioning the fastener between a load surface of the multi-piece assembly and a mating thread of the fastener to define a second friction interface between the multi-piece assembly and the fastener, the second friction interface being spaced away from the threaded region such that the first coating material does not influence the second friction interface; adjusting an amount of the first coating material applied to the threaded region in a subsequent multi-piece assembly, thereby increasing friction at the first friction interface of the subsequent multi-piece assembly compared with the first multi-piece assembly, the friction at the second friction interfaces of the first multi-piece assembly and the subsequent multi-piece assembly being substantially equal.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12, further comprising: establishing the multi-piece assemblies as connecting rods; wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive __that cures after fastener insertion__ and the second coating material includes a corrosion-resistant coating __applied to a fastener head or washer surface__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12, further comprising establishing the first coating material as being applied solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads, __wherein the first coating material comprises a curable adhesive__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12, wherein applying the first coating material includes filling the opening at least partially with a coating fluid, __wherein the coating fluid is applied exclusively to the threaded region and cures to form a solid coating layer__.
